agentSchedules.title: Agent Schedules
agentSchedules.subtitle: Routines an agent runs on a clock. Each run is an ordinary agent execution, acting as the agent's principal, with its writes governed and ledgered like any other.

form.heading: New schedule
form.agentHint: Only agents with a principal can be scheduled — a schedule has nobody at the keyboard to act as.
form.agentNone: No agents with a principal yet. Set one on the agent's Tools tab.
form.routinePlaceholder: What the agent should do each run. The named routines on the /mcp page are a good starting point.

empty.title: No schedules yet
empty.description: Create one to run a standup summary, a triage pass or a TAT sweep without anyone typing the request.

agentSchedules.footer: The clock is checked every five minutes. A paused schedule keeps its history; a removed one is gone.
agentSchedules.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can manage agent schedules.
